programme.title: Africa's Hunters
programme.desc: Bound by Blood: Three of the pride's lionesses go into labour. But with new cubs comes big danger. Across the river, three strong males are plotting to destroy their world. (S1, ep 3)

programme.title: Animal Senses
programme.desc: Super Senses: Some animals have senses that we as humans can't even begin to conceive. With those powers they can do marvellous things. (S1, ep 5)

programme.title: Animal Senses
programme.desc: Humans v Animals: Our senses give us vital information to explore our environment, and some animals have taken them and turned them into marvels of biological engineering. (S1, ep 6)

programme.title: Impossible Animals
programme.desc: Coasts: Patrick Aryee examines the amazing animals that live on the coast. From crashing waves to extreme tides, surviving here takes ingenuity and incredible adaptations. (S1, ep 3)

programme.title: Age Of The Big Cats
programme.desc: Go back in time and discover how lions conquered the world and how the tiger became the real King of the Jungle. (S1, ep 2)

programme.title: New: Cub Camp
programme.desc: Meet the X-Girls: Get to know a trio of starving orphans who turn Winston's world upside down before gentle Xola teaches him a lesson about friendship. (S1, ep 2)

programme.title: New: Evolution Earth
programme.desc: Ice: Trek to the poles, where animals are giving scientists clues about our future. Learn how polar bears, penguins and other arctic creatures can help us map global warming. (S1, ep 4)

programme.title: New: Planet Weird
programme.desc: Gangsters: Chase a band of marauding locusts, watch the coconut octopus ambush its next meal and meet a flock of finches who've developed a taste for blood. (S1, ep 6)

programme.title: Caught On Dashcam
programme.desc: From animals taking over the roads, to arguments over parking, we've got it all caught on camera. (S4, ep 4)

programme.title: FILM: Johnny Mnemonic
programme.desc: Data courier Keanu Reeves must deliver a package, stored safely inside his head, before the Japanese Yakuza hunt him down. Classic sci-fi action with Dolph Lundgren. (1995)
